tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. multi_currency_note: GlobalWallet renders 'USD 250.00' in its native currency code and is excluded from the £15,797.63 GBP total, which counts the 5-account set as declared. Rendering a USD balance with a £ sign and summing it into a GBP total are one mistake — TC-ACCTS-006 catches both ends.
credit_card_note: Platinum Mastercard renders its balance in error with a 'Balance owed' badge; the other four use the default colour and no badge. The control cases are what make the treatment meaningful (TC-ACCTS-008).
skeleton_note: loading uses 3 shimmer cards and hides the filter chips and total strip — filter chips over an empty list invite the customer to conclude the filter is broken (TC-ACCTS-002).
